booking_item_units_return_after_checkout.name: booking_item_units_return_after_checkout
booking_item_units_return_after_checkout.value: "booking_item_units"."returned_at" IS NULL OR ("booking_item_units"."checked_out_at" IS NOT NULL AND "booking_item_units"."returned_at" >= "booking_item_units"."checked_out_at")

bookings_address_required.name: bookings_address_required
bookings_address_required.value: "bookings"."address_id" IS NOT NULL OR "bookings"."delivery_type" IS NULL OR "bookings"."delivery_type" = 'pickup'

bookings_quoted_complete.name: bookings_quoted_complete
bookings_quoted_complete.value:
"bookings"."status" IN ('inquiry', 'cancelled') OR (
        "bookings"."delivery_type" IS NOT NULL
        AND "bookings"."out_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "bookings"."back_at" IS NOT NULL
        AND "bookings"."total_price_cents" IS NOT NULL
      )

gear_issues_resolution_fits_kind.name: gear_issues_resolution_fits_kind
gear_issues_resolution_fits_kind.value:
"gear_issues"."resolution" IS NULL OR "gear_issues"."resolution" = 'written_off'
        OR ("gear_issues"."kind" = 'repair' AND "gear_issues"."resolution" = 'repaired')
        OR ("gear_issues"."kind" = 'lost' AND "gear_issues"."resolution" = 'found')
